research_question: Within the frozen 10-30 dB training range, does the mixed raw I/Q observation contain reproducible target-specific information sufficient to estimate the swept MFT, VFT and ISRJ JNR when the true active composition is supplied as oracle context?

parent_failure.excluded_from_this_oracle: 35-50 dB results because they exceed the P4c 10-30 dB JNR training range

negative_and_protocol_controls.VFT.JNR: swept target without a P5b low-power systematic failure; detects indiscriminate probe claims
negative_and_protocol_controls.FMB_SawFM_SinFM_JNR: fixed at 30 dB in this sweep and therefore evaluated only as generator/entanglement controls, not as variable-JNR sufficiency targets
negative_and_protocol_controls.constant_baseline: target-specific train-role median without power input

probe_hierarchy.name: O1_analytic_composition
probe_hierarchy.input: fixed time/FFT/autocorrelation feature bank plus oracle six-bit composition
probe_hierarchy.model: ridge or one-hidden-layer MLP selected only on early

probe_hierarchy.name: O2_frozen_mlcnn_composition
probe_hierarchy.input: frozen P4c MLCNN embedding plus oracle composition

probe_hierarchy.name: O3_frozen_iqgrouped_composition
probe_hierarchy.input: frozen P4c IQ-Grouped parameter embedding plus oracle composition

probe_hierarchy.name: O4_target_specific_iqgrouped_oracle
probe_hierarchy.input: raw I/Q plus oracle composition and target identity
probe_hierarchy.model: one width-24 IQ-Grouped extractor with three target-specific scalar heads
probe_hierarchy.purpose: upper-bound learned sufficiency without exceeding the existing parameter-backbone family

training.loss: masked SmoothL1 on active finite target only
training.hyperparameter_search: none beyond the preregistered O1 ridge-versus-one-hidden-layer early choice

interpretation_rules.O1_passes: simple physical statistics are sufficient; prefer an interpretable estimator over a deep expert
interpretation_rules.O2_or_O3_passes_but_O1_fails: existing learned representation is sufficient; consider a bounded target head, not a new backbone
interpretation_rules.only_O4_passes: raw signal is sufficient but existing representations are not; a target-specific expert is allowed for a new preregistered round
interpretation_rules.O4_fails: physical sufficiency is not demonstrated; no deeper learned JNR expert may be constructed
interpretation_rules.fixed_group_control_failure: record relative-power entanglement of the frozen multitask model; do not claim fixed 30 dB targets require a physical estimator

stop_rules: Do not use P5b identities, predictions or target errors to train or select P5b1 probes.
Do not include 35-50 dB in probe selection or sufficiency claims.
Do not expose the nominal sweep power to a probe.
Do not deepen O4 or tune losses if its frozen gates fail.
A smoke or single seed validates code only and cannot establish sufficiency.
